name: easyaiconfig
description: EasyAIConfig desktop and local UI for configuring Codex providers, models, and common settings.

scripts.check: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const fs = require('node:fs'); const files = ['./src/server.js', ...fs.readdirSync('./src/lib').filter((name) => name.endsWith('.js')).map((name) => './src/lib/' + name), ...fs.readdirSync('./public').filter((name) => name.endsWith('.js')).map((name) => './public/' + name)]; for (const file of files) { const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--check', file], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.status) process.exit(result.status); }"

author: lmk1010
